card: This PR refactors transaction input and output construction in descriptor tests, BIP352 tests, group output tests, and an ephemeral spends benchmark to use declarative list initialization instead of vector resizing and member mutation. It is purely an internal test cleanup contributing to tracking issue #36692, with no change to benchmark or test behavior. It has low risk and no external dependencies.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data')
Author explicitly notes 'No change in test or benchmark behavior' (description)
problem: Test transaction inputs and outputs across several test and benchmark suites are constructed imperatively using `resize()` followed by member assignments or in-place mutations, obscuring transaction structures and default values.

risk.why: A typo in test or benchmark transaction initialization could cause a false-positive test failure or alter benchmark workloads, but cannot affect production nodes.

scope_notes: Diff not provided in input, but metadata shows a small refactoring (+33/-16) across 4 files.
summary: Refactors transaction construction in three test files and one benchmark to use declarative initializer lists rather than vector resizing and post-hoc field mutation. It touches `descriptor_tests`, `bip352_tests`, `group_outputs_tests`, and the `mempool_ephemeral_spends` benchmark without altering transaction contents or test behaviour.
